scope: Stage-2C v6/v7 cross-process replay infrastructure failure

root_cause.mechanism: LIBERO current_observation refreshes the observable cache. Event construction and capture_trace=true reconstruction executed this refresh at the initial state and every replayed action, while the old capture_trace=false path skipped runtime_trace_row entirely. The flag therefore changed simulator-observation execution, not only trace storage.

repair.description: Always execute runtime_trace_row so the observable refresh schedule is invariant; capture_trace controls only whether the already-computed row is retained.

scientific_effect: The repair removes an instrumentation-induced replay mismatch. It does not improve a policy, reinterpret Stage-2B, or provide evidence for either Stage-2C hypothesis.
